title: PIVOTSBench Task 2 record (key-frame identification)
description: Five-way multiple choice. Options are frames sampled from the clip: the ground-truth frame plus distractors at +/-5s and +/-10s from it. If a distractor timestamp falls outside the clip, a random different frame from the same clip is used instead.

options_sec.description: Timestamps of options A-E, in option order.
